meta.name: macos-freedisk
meta.description: Safely audit and reclaim disk space on macOS. Use when the user says their Mac disk is full, asks what can be safely deleted, wants to clean caches, developer artifacts, Docker Desktop storage, Homebrew/npm/pnpm/yarn caches, Xcode data, editor extensions, node_modules, logs, Trash, or asks for a repeatable macOS free-space cleanup workflow.
